'''Dryzen Wellis''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who was a [[Sith Warrior]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] during the [[Galactic War]] with the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. During the [[Invasion of Taris|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], he was stationed at the [[Toxic Lake Garrison]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Dryzen Wellis first appeared in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' by [[BioWare]] as the Sith Warrior class trainer on Taris.<ref name="TOR" />
